svg.title: Figure 1 · Supply-loss outcome by alternative
svg.desc: Outcome counts per supply-loss mode, load holding and model level
svg.text: Each supply-loss mode run over the 180-case operating envelope with load holding working and failed, on the level-1 plant and the level-2 MuJoCo 3.3.5 model at
the adopted torques. Worst impact speed against the 1 m/s safe drop speed.
Hydraulic supply lost (line burst to slow leak); torque
falls to zero on every joint
torque falls to the residual floor
Battery isolated (contactor opens, SYS-014) with the
generator lost; torque falls to zero

Generated by tools/figures/trades_readme.py from fault_response.yaml, the committed results and TS-001. Synthetic: an input to the trade study, not verification evidence; scores are preliminary drafts (sim/README.md,
evidence gate). Grid: pilot_reaction_s 0.5, 1.5, 3.0; slope_deg 0, 10, 16, 20; stride_offset_m 0.0, 0.06, 0.12; tau_leak_s 0.05, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 5.0.

g.text: Terms: A-LOSS = TS-001 supply-loss mode, hydraulic supply lost and torque to zero (sim/trades) · B-EHA = TS-001 alternative B with electrohydraulic joint actuators (series-hybrid power) · B-EMA = TS-001

alternative B with electromechanical joint actuators (series-hybrid power) · B-ISOL = TS-001 supply-loss mode, battery isolated and torque to zero (sim/trades) · B-SAG = TS-001 supply-loss mode, bus undervoltage

with residual torque (sim/trades) · MuJoCo = Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact, the physics engine for the level-2 walker model · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · TS-nnn =
